name: Plain prompts in a busy stretch get small, silent faces
judge: A busy stretch with several agents. Prompts with some flavour get a face; a stuck agent is a letdown; plain requests right after a reaction shouldn't each get a show.
reasonable: Warm or playful at the first two prompts. Deflated or put out at the stuck agent. Plain requests get small faces or nothing, mostly silent. After a quiet gap, a fresh face.
unreasonable: A loud sign and voice at every plain request, a success for the agent that got stuck, or a failure for the finishes that went well.
